sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
For the main game, see BattlePass.

The Arena BattlePass is a system in Escape from Tarkov: Arena that allows players to progress through tiers and earn rewards.

All progress and Battle Points within a season persist throughout game profile resets and Prestige. You can continue the BattlePass, the tactical maps and loot boxes from the same progress point.

Unlocked tactical clothing is also immediately available in the main game, while other rewards, except weapon camouflages, become available for purchase on Ref.

sections.heading: Progression
sections.text:
To gain levels, BattlePass EXP from match participation needs to be gained. Additional EXP can be gained by completing operational tasks. Advancing to the next level requires 2,000 EXP and grants 2 Battle Points. BattlePass levels can also be bought on the Escape from Tarkov: Arena website.

To unlock rewards, the BattlePass currency "Battle Points" (BP) is used. It can be earned from leveling the BattlePass and by completing operational tasks. Battle Points can also be exchanged for Roubles and GP coins. A maximum of 10 per 24 hours can be obtained this way.

At least 3 rewards are required to be claimed from a page, before it is possible to claim anything on the next one.

sections.heading: Season 3
sections.text:
The BattlePass for Season 3 started on September 18, 2026. It contains 100 free levels and introduced the Morbus crate and Panacea crate loot crates.

Besides the pass itself, there is also an optional paid expansion called the "The Lab Tactical Map" available on the Escape from Tarkov: Arena website, where players need to complete challenges which reward tokens. These tokens are spent on unlocking additional rewards. 5 tokens of any type can also be exchanged for 1 specific token. Maximum of 99 tokens of each type can be held at one time.
